contact_witnesses: For every scanned scale, verify the lower-sign maximizer at the center with the largest near-contact residual. This diagnoses the fixed model and is not a training or checkpoint selection.
reference_value: Used only to enclose actual error; not used to measure contact or Bellman residuals. Analytic problem structure supplies L_V and hold-bias bound.
timing: One sequential CPU process; common Lipschitz verification and network evaluations recorded separately from each estimator.
